en.p: Find the number of ways to distribute all of 4 white balls and 4 black balls among three students $\mathrm{A}$, $\mathrm{B}$, $\mathrm{C}$ according to the following rules. (Balls of the same color are indistinguishable, and a student may receive no balls.) [4 points]

box: (A) The number of balls student $\mathrm{A}$ receives is at least 0 and at most 2.
(B) The number of balls student $\mathrm{B}$ receives is at least 2.
